_note: typed-fields-and-indicators-on-a-party. A party carries typed fields of its own and standing indicators that show on every case and every contact moment of theirs. The typed values hang on pipelinq's relationship record beside the identity mirrors unify-client-contact defines, because a Nextcloud Contact holds extension fields as untyped strings with no schema, no validation and no choice list. Identity stays on the Contact; anything only this organisation cares about is here.

partyFieldSet.title: Party field set
partyFieldSet.description: Declares which typed properties a kind of party carries. An administrator adds a field without a schema release; OpenRegister does the typing, so this is a declaration and not a second field engine.

partyKind.title: Party kind
partyKind.description: The code of the party kind this field belongs to, as declared in the party kind registry.

key.title: Key
key.description: The property name the value is stored under on the party record. Stable: renaming it orphans the values already written.

label.title: Label
label.description: What a handler reads beside the field.

fieldKind.title: Field kind
fieldKind.description: The type of the value. The vocabulary osTicket's form types cover, and no more: a longer list belongs to the case type depth study, not here.

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: The code list a choice field draws from. Empty for every other field kind.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether a party of this kind must carry a value.

order.title: Order
order.description: Where the field sits among the others. Part of the declaration, not re-sorted for display.

partyIndicator.title: Party indicator
partyIndicator.description: The vocabulary: what an indicator means and what it asserts about handling. An indicator is not a boolean per concern, because every new concern would then be a schema change, and it is not a tag, because a tag has no severity, no period, no source and no declared effect.

code.title: Code
code.description: The stable code a value points at, for example overleden, geheimhouding-adres, bewindvoering or agressie-registratie.

label.title: Label
label.description: What a handler reads on the party, and what a refusal names.

description.title: Description
description.description: What this indicator means for the people handling the work.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: How loudly a surface says it.

blocksOutbound.title: Blocks outbound
blocksOutbound.description: Whether anything may be sent to this party. Writing to somebody who died last month is the failure this prevents.

blocksAddressPublication.title: Blocks address publication
blocksAddressPublication.description: Whether this party's address may be published.

requiresAcknowledgement.title: Requires acknowledgement
requiresAcknowledgement.description: Whether a handler must confirm they have seen this before working the party.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the indicator is offered for new values. An inactive indicator keeps resolving on values already written.

partyIndicatorValue.title: Party indicator value
partyIndicatorValue.description: One indicator held on one party, with a period and the source that set it. There is no copy of this on a case, a contact moment, a task or a message: an indicator set today has to show on work opened at any earlier date, and one lifted today has to stop showing everywhere at once.

party.title: Party
party.description: The party record this value is held on.

indicator.title: Indicator
indicator.description: The code of the declared indicator this value is an instance of.

validFrom.title: Valid from
validFrom.description: The day the indicator starts applying.

validUntil.title: Valid until
validUntil.description: The last day it applies. A value past this date stops applying on its own date, with nobody editing it.

source.title: Source
source.description: Who or what set it: a BRP lookup and a KCC supervisor are both true and are challenged differently, so the source is recorded rather than inferred.

acknowledgedBy.title: Acknowledged by
acknowledgedBy.description: The handler who confirmed they had seen it, when the indicator requires an acknowledgement.

fieldValues.title: Field values
fieldValues.description: The values of the typed fields this party's kind declares, keyed by the field set's key. Held here, beside the denormalised identity mirrors, because a Nextcloud Contact cannot hold a typed, validated, choice-bearing field. Identity stays on the Contact.

parentOrganisation.title: Parent organisation
parentOrganisation.description: The organisation this one sits under. The CUSTOMER organisation, not the internal one: a gemeente's own afdelingen are org units, and a housing corporation with six regional offices is a customer tree. A parent that would close a cycle is refused on the write.

organisationPath.title: Organisation path
organisationPath.description: The materialised path from the root to this node, slash separated. Materialised because the common read is everything under one afdeling, and walking that recursively per read against an object store is slow enough to matter on a real municipal tree. Moving a node rewrites its subtree's paths in the same act.

fieldValues.title: Field values
fieldValues.description: The values of the typed fields this party's kind declares, keyed by the field set's key.
